# @mission-platform/hunspell

Hunspell spell checker compiled to WebAssembly via Emscripten.

## Usage
Integrate Hunspell spell-checking capabilities into your application using the provided WASM-based utilities.

## Framework-agnostic Monaco core (`attachHunspellMonaco`)

The Vue `useHunspellMonaco` composable is a thin reactive wrapper around the
framework-agnostic `attachHunspellMonaco(editor, monaco, language?)` core, which
is the single source of truth for the imperative Hunspell ↔ Monaco integration
(worker spawn, debounced checking, marker mapping, quick-fix code-action
provider) and returns a `{ dispose, recheck }` handle. Non-Vue consumers (e.g.
the write-once `@mission-platform/components` `ForgeMonacoEditor`) import it
directly:

```ts
import { attachHunspellMonaco } from '@mission-platform/hunspell'

const handle = attachHunspellMonaco(editor, monacoRuntime, 'plaintext')
// later: handle.dispose()
```
